subtopics.title: How the Finance Practice Paper Is Built and How Marks Are Won

questions.question: Question One of the practice paper is:
options: 30 marks of short, single-step items only, from Finance and Data Handling
The hardest question, saved for strong candidates

questions.question: In the practice paper, the two big families and their roles are:
options: Measurement in Question Two, Maps in Question Three
Finance in Question Two, Data Handling in Question Three, mixed in Questions Four and Five
Data first, Finance banned from the back end

questions.question: The less familiar contexts were placed:
options: In the mixed Questions Four and Five

questions.question: The follow-through principle in the marking plan means:
options: Later stages still pay when a wrong earlier value is carried forward correctly — so finish the chain

questions.question: VAT at 15% on a R180,00 stationery pack, for two marks:
Gross salary R14 650,00, deductions R2 980,00. Net pay:
options: R11 670,00 — net is what remains after deductions

questions.question: Even on two-mark items, working is written because:
options: A slip beside visible method usually keeps one mark; a slip with no working forfeits both

questions.question: Tariff: first 100 kWh at R1,80; 101–400 at R2,40; above 400 at R3,10. For 460 kWh, the blocks are:
options: 400 kWh at R1,80 and 60 at R2,40

questions.question: The bill including VAT on the R1 086,00 subtotal:
options: R1 086,00 — prepaid electricity carries no VAT

questions.question: Writing each block on its own line earns marks because:
options: Each block is a stage of the chain — the cheap first block still absorbs 100 of the 460 units

questions.question: The classic tariff error is:
options: Using kilowatt hours as the unit
Charging all 460 units at the top rate because 460 falls in that block's range — the table is a staircase, not a switch

subtopics.title: Question 2.2: Compound Interest on a Fixed Deposit

questions.question: R9 500,00 at 7,2% compounded annually: the end of year one is:
After three years the deposit is worth:
options: R11 703,29 — each year's 1,072 applied to the NEW balance

questions.question: The interest earned over the term:
options: R2 203,29 — final value minus the original deposit

questions.question: Against simple interest at the same rate, compound wins by R151,29 because:
options: The bank charges simple savers a fee
Simple interest runs for fewer years
From year two onward, compound interest is calculated on a balance that already contains interest

questions.question: Ten arranged marks with sum 590: the mean is:
With ten values, the median is:
options: The average of the fifth and sixth values — (57 + 61) ÷ 2 = 59,0

questions.question: Q1 = 49 and Q3 = 68, so the interquartile range is:
options: 19 — the spread of the middle half, untouched by the 41 and the 79

questions.question: Commenting on 'the group did well because the mean is 59' earns marks by:
options: Citing computed values — mean 59,0 beside median 59,0, yet a quarter of the group below Q1 = 49

subtopics.title: Question 4: Integrated Finance, Data and Probability

questions.question: Three of the ten learners scored below 50%. P(a randomly chosen learner scored below 50%):
options: 3/10 = 0,3 = 30% — any dialect unless one is demanded

questions.question: 150 cans bought at R7,20 and all sold at R12,00 gives a profit of:
options: R720,00 — income R1 800,00 minus costs R1 080,00

questions.question: If only 80% of the 150 cans sell, profit becomes:
options: R360,00 — 120 × R12,00 = R1 440,00 income against the full R1 080,00 cost

questions.question: To clear a R950,00 profit target on 120 sales, the price must round UP to R16,92 because:
options: R16,91 × 120 banks only R2 029,20 — eighty cents short of the R2 030,00 needed

questions.question: The method mark is banked the moment:
options: Correct values sit inside a correct structure on paper — like 1 086 × 1,15 written down

questions.question: On suspecting a slip mid-question, the right move is:
options: Stop and leave the rest blank
Carry the value forward and finish — follow-through keeps paying the later stages

questions.question: Money answers take the form:
options: Rand sign, two decimals, decimal comma — R1 248,90

questions.question: The quiet mark-killer in long chains is:
options: Premature rounding mid-chain — keep full figures until the final line
